feeds.title: Elaine Uskoski Blog
feeds.description: The blog aims at educating parents on the risk factors associated with video game addiction. Elaine is an Author, Speaker, Coach for Video Gaming Addiction.

feeds.title: Game Quitters Blog
feeds.description: Read our best tips, guides, and articles on overcoming video game addiction. Game Quitters is the largest support community for video game addiction.

feeds.title: Omega Recovery » Video Gaming Addiction
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with video gaming addiction. Omega Recovery is a holistic, nationally-recognized and accredited treatment center providing the best addiction and mental health care in Texas.

feeds.title: Computer Gaming Addicts Anonymous » Gaming Addiction
feeds.description: Computer Gaming Addicts Anonymous is a fellowship of people who support each other in recovering from the problems resulting from excessive game playing. Our single purpose is to abstain from video gaming and to help others find freedom from compulsive gaming.

feeds.title: Foothills at Red Oak Recovery » Gaming Addiction
feeds.description: Posts on gaming addiction, adolescent addiction and recovery. At Foothills at Red Oak Recovery, we work with individuals between the ages of 14 to 17 who struggle with a wide range of issues from gaming addiction to substance use, We understand the unique challenges this age group faces.

feeds.title: Stonewater Adolescent Recovery Center » Gaming Addiction
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles related to gaming addiction. Stonewater is a comprehensive substance use disorder treatment center, addressing adolescent needs across a continuum of care.
